verdict.rationale: LangGraph's Python/JS graph API (nodes, edges, streaming, checkpointers, interrupts) is extensively documented (docs-1..docs-23), and a CLI/Agent Server exists to expose it as a runnable service. However, probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (langgraph-probe-3 all 404), and community comments (langgraph-comm-7, langgraph-comm-13) indicate friction and incomplete guidance for deploying/consuming it as a production API.
